back: Connects a device to a network medium and holds its MAC address.
A unique hardware address set in a NIC; used to identify the device on a LAN.
Learns the MAC address behind each port and forwards a frame only to the destination port; floods if the address is unknown.
Connects different networks and forwards packets by IP address; its LAN address is the default gateway.
Repeater regenerates a weak signal. Bridge joins two LAN segments and passes only the frames that must cross.
The router address to which a device sends packets whose destination is outside its own network.
A router replaces private source addresses with its public address so many devices share one public address.
Listen; transmit if idle; detect a collision; send a jam signal; wait a random back-off; retry.
